id: 16182_电信工具调用-参数提取-实参提取-提取后计算_8625
question:
<用户问题>：“能否提供下东区有线教学楼1栋今天下午1点10分到3点20分设备b4:0b:68:85:45:6a的平均功率”
你的任务是提取<用户问题>中参数的值，以下是参数描述：
startTime:
  描述: startTime是一个表示用户输入的“开始时间”的字符串。如果用户的输入包含完整的日期和时间，例如“X年X月X日”，那么开始时间的格式将为“YYYY-MM-DD hh:mm:ss”。如果输入中没有具体日期，但包含相对时间，例如“今天早上”、“周三晚上8点”或“2天前”，开始时间的格式将为“XX hh:mm:ss”，其中“XX”是相对时间表达，如“今天”、“周三”或“2天前”。某一年的开始时间是该年1月1日00:00:00；某个月的开始时间是该月1日00:00:00；某一天的开始时间是当天的00:00:00；“早上”的开始时间是当天的00:00:00；“下午”的开始时间是当天的12:00:00；“晚上”的开始时间是当天的18:00:00。若用户问题中没有出现相关时间描述，开始时间默认为""。
  类型: string
endTime:
  描述: endTime是一个表示用户输入的“结束时间”的字符串。如果用户的输入包含完整的日期和时间，例如“X年X月X日”，那么结束时间的格式为“YYYY-MM-DD hh:mm:ss”。如果输入中没有具体日期，但包含相对日期，例如“今天早上”或“周三晚上8点”，结束时间的格式将为“XX hh:mm:ss”，其中“XX”表示相对日期，如“今天”或“周三”。如果用户的输入中包含指示过去时间范围的短语，如“最近”、“过去”、“之前”或“上次”，结束时间将为“现在（now）”。某一年的结束时间为该年12月31日23:59:59；某个月的结束时间为该月的最后一天23:59:59；某一天的结束时间为当天的23:59:59；“早上”的结束时间为当天的11:59:59；“下午”的结束时间为当天的17:59:59；“晚上”的结束时间为当天的23:59:59。若用户问题中没有出现相关时间描述，开始时间默认为""。
  类型: string
regionName:
  描述: regionName是一个表示用户输入的“行政区域”或“地点位置”的字符串，普遍由一组或多组数字、汉字或英文字母组成，组成部分之间通过“-”等符号连接。
  类型: string
sortType:
  描述: 排序方式，可以支持升序和降序。当用户问题表示查询网络质量差的信息时，sortType为asc，表示升序，网络质量差同义词包括“强度不好”、“信号不佳”、“网体验差”、“体验差”等关键词。当用户问题表示查询网络质量好的信息时，sortType为desc，表示降序，网络质量好同义词包括“强度高”、“信号好”、“网速快”、“体验好”等关键词。
  类型: string
  可选项列表: [desc, asc]
limit:
  描述: limit表示返回的查询结果的数量
  类型: integer
aggregationType:
  描述: 汇聚类型。aggregationType为last，表示最新值；aggregationType为last，表示最新值；aggregationType为max，表示最大值；aggregationType为min，表示最小值；aggregationType为average，表示平均值；aggregationType为sum，表示累计值。
  类型: string
  可选项列表: [last, max, min, average, sum]
queryType:
  类型: string
  描述: 查询类型。目前只支持聚合查询，queryType为aggregation。
metricType:
  类型: array
  描述: deviceMetricType是一个列表，只包含一个枚举值。枚举值表示设备指标的类型。
  枚举值及对应含义:
    channelUsage: 信道利用率
    connetuser: 链接用户数
    interferenceratio: 干扰率
    pressuretocap: 拥塞数
    channel: 当前信道
    appower: 当前功率
    band_width: 当前频宽
    band: 频段
    radioId: 射频id
    cpu_rate: CPU利用率
    memory_rate: 内存利用率
    cap_cpu_rate: 转发核利用率
    ap_buffer: CAP Buffer使用率
    device_ipca_flow_usage: 设备iPCA流表利用率
    realtime_power: 实时功率
    average_power: 平均功率
    related_power: 额定功率
    nhp_usage: NHP表项利用率
    nd_usage: ND表项利用率
    mac_usage: MAC表项利用率
    ipmc_usage: IPMC表项利用率
    ipmcvlan_usage: IPMC VLAN表项利用率
    rule_usage: ACL Rule表项利用率
    meter_usage: ACL Meter表项利用率
    counter_usage: ACL Counter表项利用率
    arp_usage: ARP表项利用率
    fibv4_usage: FIBv4表项利用率
    fibv6_usage: FIBv6表项利用率
    nand_bad_block: NAND Flash坏块数量总和
    nor_erase: NOR Flash擦写次数总和
    sac_session_usage: SAC会话利用率
    sac_flow_usage: SAC流表利用率
    emdi_session_usage: eMDI会话利用率
    ipca_flow_usage: 单板iPCA流表利用率
    pse_available_power: PSE可用总功率
    board_realtime_power: 电源实时功率
    board_related_power: 电源额定功率
    board_current: 电源电流
    board_voltage: 电源电压
    recv_pkts_cnt: 接收包数
    send_pkts_cnt: 发送包数
    recv_bytes: 接收字节数
    send_bytes: 发送字节数
    recv_drop_pkts_cnt: 接收丢包数
    send_drop_pkts_cnt: 发送丢包数
    recv_error_pkts_cnt: 接收错包数
    send_error_pkts_cnt: 发送错包数
    recv_uni_pkts_cnt: 单播接收包数
    send_uni_pkts_cnt: 单播发送包数
    recv_multi_pkts_cnt: 组播接收包数
    send_multi_pkts_cnt: 组播发送包数
    recv_broad_pkts_cnt: 广播接收包数
    send_broad_pkts_cnt: 广播发送包数
    conflict_loss_pkts_cnt: 端口冲突丢包数
    input_bandwidth_percent: 接收带宽占用率
    input_byte_rate: 接收速率
    input_packet_rate: 接收包速率
    output_bandwidth_percent: 发送带宽占用率
    output_byte_rate: 发送速率
    output_packet_rate: 发送包速率
    port_buffer_used: 接口缓存占用
    buffer_max_usage: 接口缓存利用率峰值
    mode: 协商速率
    ipv4_recv_bytes: IPv4接收字节数
    ipv4_recv_pkgs: IPv4接受包数
    ipv4_send_bytes: IPv4发送字节数
    ipv4_send_pkgs: IPv4发送包数
    ipv6_recv_bytes: IPv6接收字节数
    ipv6_recv_pkgs: IPv6接受包数
    ipv6_send_bytes: IPv6发送字节数
    ipv6_send_pkgs: IPv6发送包数
    ipv6_recv_traffic_percent: IPv6接收流量占比
    ipv6_send_traffic_percent: IPv6发送流量占比
    pd_current_power: Pd实时功率
    pd_average_power: Pd平均功率
    pd_reference_power: Pd额定功率
    ap_drop: CAP流水线丢包数
    tx_power_dbm: 光模块发送功率
    rx_power_dbm: 光模块接收功率
    bias_cur: 光模块电流
    voltage: 光模块电压
    temperature: 光模块温度
    queue_buffer_max_usage: 队列缓存利用率峰值
    queue_pass_pkts: 队列发送包数
    queue_pass_bytes: 队列发送字节数
    queue_drop_pkts: 队列丢弃包数
    queue_drop_bytes: 队列丢弃字节数
filter:
  类型: array
  描述: 过滤条件
  properties:
    operate:
      描述: 筛选表达式，"="表示包含，"=="表示等于，"!="表示"不包含"，">"表示大于，"<"表示小于。
      类型: string
      可选项列表: ['=', <, '>', ==, '!=']
    key:
      描述: 筛选关键词，表示设备指标的类型。
      类型: string
    value:
      描述: 筛选值，和metricType一样表示设备指标的值。
      类型: string
deviceConf:
  类型: object
  描述: deviceConf表示设备信息，可以从设备MAC地址、设备名称、单板名称、端口名称、频段和射频Id多个方面表示。
  properties:
    deviceMac:
      描述: 设备MAC地址
      类型: string
    deviceName:
      描述: 设备名称
      类型: string
    slotName:
      描述: 单板名称
      类型: string
    portName:
      描述: 端口名称
      类型: string
    band:
      描述: 频段
      类型: integer
    radioId:
      描述: 射频Id
      类型: integer
必填参数：None
备注：无

   description:  time是一个字符串字段，用于解析用户输入的时间信息，并生成一个表示时间范围的字符串，如[开始时间, 结束时间]。如果用户输入包括具体的日期和时间，如YYYY年MM月DD日hh时mm分ss秒，time将直接使用这个具体时间点，格式为[YYYY-MM-DD hh:mm:ss, YYYY-MM-DD hh:mm:ss]。但是，当用户输入的是模糊时间，如今天上午、上周、上个月，time将自动扩展为对应的时间范围，如[今天 00:00:00, 今天 11:59:59]、[上周一 00:00:00, 上周日 23:59:59]、[上个月1日 00:00:00, 上个月31日 23:59:59]。如果用户输入的时间信息缺失“开始时间”，开始时间将默认为“今天 00:00:00”；如果缺失“结束时间”，结束时间将默认为“现在”。
   type: string
   required: true
timeDim:
   description: 查询时间维度，支持小时：hour；天：day；周：week；月：month。当用户指定查询的时间维度时，输入为对应的维度，比如“小时维度的值”表示timeDim为“小时”，“天维度的值”表示timeDim为“天”，比如“周维度的值”表示timeDim为“周”，“月维度的值”表示timeDim为“月”，“日均”表示timeDim为“day”，“周均”表示timeDim为“week”，“月均”表示timeDim为“month”，timeDim默认值为day。
   type: string
   required: true
   enum:
     - hour
     - day
     - week
     - month
rat:
   description: 网络制式，可能的取值包括"4G"、"5G"。用户问题中未明确指定时，可以从查询指标上判断，比如查询VoLTE接通率时，网络制式为4G，因为VoLTE是4G网络的特性。
   type: string
   required: true
object:
   description: 查询对象，可以是小区或对象组。对象组有时对应一个行政区，如杭州市、萧山区、淳安县。
   type: string
   required: true
counters:
   description: 查询指标列表，支持一个或多个。如果用户按专题查询，则指标列表取值为专题包含的所有指标。如用户查询4G网络的接通专题，指标列表取值为["无线接通率(%)", "VOLTE接通率(%)"]
   type: array
   required: true
   items:
     type: string
filterOperation: 
   description: 过滤方式,数据过滤时需要根据用户意图提取对比方式,filterOperation的值:1. 过滤方式，输入等于时filterOperation为"="，输入大于时filterOperation为">"，输入小于时filterOperation为"<"，输入大于等于时filterOperation为">="，输入小于等于时filterOperation为"<="，输入不等于时filterOperation为"!="，2. 过滤方式，输入为最好、最佳、最高时filterOperation为"top"，输入为最差、最低、最少时filterOperation为"bottom"
   type: string
   required: true
filterValue:
   description: 过滤值,当输入方式为"="、">"、"<"时，需要填具体的值不体现单位，该取值单位需要与counters字段值单位保持一致，当上下文提取的数值单位不一致时需要做单位转换，比如：速率单位转换公式：1MBps=8Mbps，1MB/S=1024KB/S=1024*8Kb/s=8192Kb/s，再比如：1GB流量=1024MB流量。
   type: string
   required: true

## [经验知识]
### 对象组
对象组包括：
- 杭州
- 萧山
- 拱墅
### 性能指标
指标可以按照专题和知识进行分类，如下是各专题分类名称和4G/5G下对应的指标：
- 接通
4G：无线接通率(%)，VOLTE接通率(%)
5G：无线接通率(%)，NSA DC辅站添加成功率(%)
- 掉话
4G：无线掉线率(%)，VOLTE掉话率(%)
5G：无线掉线率(%)，NSA DC SgNB触发的辅站异常释放率(%)
- 切换
4G：切换成功率(%)
5G：切换成功率(%)
- 体验
4G：上行用户体验平均速率(Mbps)，下行用户体验平均速率(Mbps)，上行体验速率(Mbps)，下行体验速率(Mbps)
5G：上行用户平均速率(Mbps)，下行用户平均速率(Mbps)
- 业务量
4G：VOLTE语音话务量(erl)，4G上行流量(GB)，4G下行流量(GB)，4G总流量(GB)
5G：PDCP上行流量(GB)，PDCP下行流量(GB)，PDCP总流量(GB)
- 负载
4G：小区内的平均用户数，小区内的最大用户数，平均激活用户数，最大激活用户数，上行PRB利用率(%)，下行PRB利用率(%)，CCE利用率(%)
5G：RRC平均用户数，RRC最大用户数，平均激活用户数，最大激活用户数，上行PRB平均利用率(%)，下行PRB平均利用率(%)，PDCCH CCE利用率(%)
- 干扰
4G：上行平均干扰(dBm)
5G：上行平均干扰(dBm)
- 丢包
5G：小区RLC层下行丢包率(%)
如果用户是对专题进行查询，需要根据查询的专题和制式选择对应的指标填入参数列表
###网络制式
如果用户没有指定制式时，由于某些指标和制式强绑定，可以通过指标进行制式的映射。
如下指标是4G独有：
VOLTE接通率(%)，VOLTE掉话率(%)，VOLTE语音话务量(erl)，4G上行流量(GB)，4G下行流量(GB)，4G总流量(GB)
如下指标是5G独有：
NSA DC辅站添加成功率(%)，NSA DC SgNB触发的辅站异常释放率(%)，PDCP上行流量(GB)，PDCP下行流量(GB)，PDCP总流量(GB)
### 约束
当用户没有指定制式时才需要通过指标进行制式判断，仅当指标满足上述映射时才选择对应的制式；
### 电平值单位 
dBm跟W之间的单位换算公式：dBm=10lg(功率值/1mw)
pW：皮瓦
nW：纳瓦
mW：毫瓦
W：瓦
kW：千瓦
MW：兆瓦
1W=1000mW
1kW=1000W
1MW=1000000W=1000kW
1nW=0.000000001W
1pW=0.000000000001W

id: 16130_电信工具调用-参数提取-实参提取-提取后计算_7988
question:
你是一个电信领域的参数提取智能体，负责从**当前参数列表**中提取并返回所需的工具参数。你需要结合**上下文**和**经验知识**，确保所提取的参数准确无误。

## [任务要求]
1. 根据**当前参数列表**中的可选/必选说明字段，结合**经验知识**、**用户问题**、**上下文**和**当前节点描述**，提取当前所需的参数，**上下文**和**当前节点描述**可能为空。
2. **参数值要求**：确保提取的参数值完全符合其类型要求和取值范围；参数值必须直接来自**上下文**，或可从已明确提到的信息中得出的必然结论，不允许通过推测得出。
3. 以JSON格式返回所有提取的参数。

## [输入]
### <当前参数列表>
time:
   description:  time是一个字符串字段，用于解析用户输入的时间信息，并生成一个表示时间范围的字符串，如[开始时间, 结束时间]。如果用户输入包括具体的日期和时间，如YYYY年MM月DD日hh时mm分ss秒，time将直接使用这个具体时间点，格式为[YYYY-MM-DD hh:mm:ss, YYYY-MM-DD hh:mm:ss]。但是，当用户输入的是模糊时间，如今天上午、上周、上个月，time将自动扩展为对应的时间范围，如[今天 00:00:00, 今天 11:59:59]、[上周一 00:00:00, 上周日 23:59:59]、[上个月1日 00:00:00, 上个月31日 23:59:59]。如果用户输入的时间信息缺失“开始时间”，开始时间将默认为“今天 00:00:00”；如果缺失“结束时间”，结束时间将默认为“现在”。
   type: string
   required: true
timeDim:
   description: 查询时间维度，支持小时：hour；天：day；周：week；月：month。当用户指定查询的时间维度时，输入为对应的维度，比如“小时维度的值”表示timeDim为“小时”，“天维度的值”表示timeDim为“天”，比如“周维度的值”表示timeDim为“周”，“月维度的值”表示timeDim为“月”，“日均”表示timeDim为“day”，“周均”表示timeDim为“week”，“月均”表示timeDim为“month”，timeDim默认值为day。
   type: string
   required: true
   enum:
     - hour
     - day
     - week
     - month
rat:
   description: 网络制式，可能的取值包括"4G"、"5G"。用户问题中未明确指定时，可以从查询指标上判断，比如查询VoLTE接通率时，网络制式为4G，因为VoLTE是4G网络的特性。
   type: string
   required: true
object:
   description: 查询对象，可以是小区或对象组。对象组有时对应一个行政区，如杭州市、萧山区、淳安县。
   type: string
   required: true
counters:
   description: 查询指标列表，支持一个或多个。如果用户按专题查询，则指标列表取值为专题包含的所有指标。如用户查询4G网络的接通专题，指标列表取值为["无线接通率(%)", "VOLTE接通率(%)"]
   type: array
   required: true
   items:
     type: string
filterOperation: 
   description: 过滤方式,数据过滤时需要根据用户意图提取对比方式,filterOperation的值:1. 过滤方式，输入等于时filterOperation为"="，输入大于时filterOperation为">"，输入小于时filterOperation为"<"，输入大于等于时filterOperation为">="，输入小于等于时filterOperation为"<="，输入不等于时filterOperation为"!="，2. 过滤方式，输入为最好、最佳、最高时filterOperation为"top"，输入为最差、最低、最少时filterOperation为"bottom"
   type: string
   required: true
filterValue:
   description: 过滤值,当输入方式为"="、">"、"<"时，需要填具体的值不体现单位，该取值单位需要与counters字段值单位保持一致，当上下文提取的数值单位不一致时需要做单位转换，比如：速率单位转换公式：1MBps=8Mbps，1MB/S=1024KB/S=1024*8Kb/s=8192Kb/s，再比如：1GB流量=1024MB流量。
   type: string
   required: true

## [经验知识]
### 对象组
对象组包括：
- 杭州
- 萧山
- 拱墅
### 性能指标
指标可以按照专题和知识进行分类，如下是各专题分类名称和4G/5G下对应的指标：
- 接通
4G：无线接通率(%)，VOLTE接通率(%)
5G：无线接通率(%)，NSA DC辅站添加成功率(%)
- 掉话

question:
<User Question>：“Please check the average receiving packet rate for the tx-ap-a3 device in Shanghai/H1 on August 15, 2023.”
Your task is to extract the values of the parameters in the <User Question>. Below is the description of the parameters:
startTime:
  Description: startTime is a string that indicates the "start time" entered by the user. If user input includes a complete date and time, such as "MM DD, YYYY", the format of the start time would be written as "YYYY-MM-DD hh:mm:ss". If the input does not contain a specific date, but contains a relative time, such as "this morning", "8 PM on Wednesday", or "2 days ago", the start time format is "XX hh:mm:ss", where "XX" represents a relative time expression, such as "today", "Wednesday", or "2 days ago". The start time for a year is 00:00:00 January 1 of that year; the start time for a month is 00:00:00 on the 1st of that month; the start time for a day is 00:00:00 of that day; the start time for "morning" is 00:00:00 of that day; the start time for "afternoon" is 12:00:00 of that day; the start time for "evening" is 18:00:00 of that day. If there is no relevant time description in the user question, the default start time is "".
  Type: string
endTime:
  Description: endTime is a string representing the "end time" entered by the user. If user input includes a complete date and time, such as "MM DD, YYYY", the format of end time would be "YYYY-MM-DD hh:mm:ss". If user input includes phrases indicating a past time range, such as "recently", "past", "before", or "last time", the end time will be "now". The end time for a year is 23:59:59 December 31 of that year; the end time for a month is 23:59:59 of the last day of that month; the end time for a day is 23:59:59 of that day; the end time for "morning" is 11:59:59 of that day; the end time for "afternoon" is 17:59:59 of that day; the end time for "evening" is 23:59:59 of that day. If there is no relevant time description in the user question, the default end time is "".
  Type: string
regionName:
  Description: regionName is a string that indicates the "administrative region" or "location" entered by the user, and is generally composed of one or several groups of numbers, Chinese characters, or English letters. The components are connected by symbols such as "-".
  Type: string
sortType:
  Description: The sorting method, it can support ascending and descending. When user requests to query information about poor network quality, sortType is 'asc' which represents ascending. Synonyms for poor network quality include "bad signal", "poor signal", "bad internet experience", and "bad experience". When user requests to query information about good network quality, sortType is 'desc' and represents descending. Synonyms for good network quality include "high signal", "good signal", "fast internet speed", and "good experience". The default is 'desc'.
  Type: string
  Optional parameter list: [desc, asc]
limit:
  Description: limit denotes the number of query results to be returned, default is null.
  Type: integer
  Default value: null
aggregationType:
  Description: The type of aggregation. When aggregationType is 'last', it represents the latest value; when it is 'max', it represents the maximum value; when it is 'min', it represents the minimum value; when it is 'average', it represents the average value; when it is 'sum', it represents the cumulative value.
  Type: string
  Optional parameter list: [last, max, min, average, sum]
queryType:
  Type: string
  Description: Query type. Currently only aggregate queries are supported, queryType is 'aggregation'.
metricType:
  Type: array
  Description: deviceMetricType is a list, which contains only one enumeration value. The enumeration value indicates the type of device indicator.
  Enumeration values and their corresponding meanings:
    channelUsage: Channel utilization rate
    connectuser: Connected user count
    interferenceratio: Interference ratio
    pressuretocap: Congestion number
    channel: Current channel
    appower: Current power
    band_width: Current bandwidth
    band: Frequency band
    radioId: Radio frequency id
    cpu_rate: CPU utilization rate
    memory_rate: Memory utilization rate
    cap_cpu_rate: Forwarding core utilization rate
    ap_buffer: CAP Buffer usage rate
    device_ipca_flow_usage: Device iPCA flow table usage rate
    realtime_power: Real-time power
    average_power: Average power
    related_power: Rated power
    nhp_usage: NHP entry utilization rate
    nd_usage: ND item utilization rate
    mac_usage: MAC item utilization rate

question:

## [Task Requirements]
1. Based on the optional/mandatory explanation field in the **current parameter list**, combine **knowledge**, **user questions**, **context**, and **current node description** to extract the needed parameters for now; **context** and **current node description** could be empty.
2. **Parameter Value Requirements**: Ensure that the extracted parameter values completely meet their type requirements and range of values; parameter values must come directly from the **context**, or must be the inevitable conclusion drawn from the clearly mentioned information, and cannot be attained through speculation.
3. Return all extracted parameters in JSON format.

## [Input]
### <Current Parameter List>
time:
   description: time is a string field that is used to parse the user's input time information and generate a string that represents a range of time, such as [start time, end time]. However, when the user's input is vague time, such as this morning, last week, last month, time will automatically expand into the corresponding time range, such as [today 00:00:00, today 11:59:59], [last Monday 00:00:00, last Sunday 23:59:59], [last month 1st 00:00:00, last month 31st 23:59:59].    description: Query time dimension, support hour; day; week; month.    required: true

   type: string
   required: true

## [Knowledge]
### Object group
Object groups include:
- HangZhou
- XiaoShan
- GongShu
### Theme List
KQIs/KPIs can be classified by topic and knowledge. The following table lists the name of each theme and the corresponding KQIs/KPIs under 4G/5G.
- Connect
4G: Radio Access Success Rate(%), VoLTE Access Success Rate(%)
5G: Radio Access Success Rate(%), NSA DC SgNB Add Success Rate(%)
- Call drop
4G: Wireless Call Drop Rate(%), VoLTE Call Drop Rate(%)
5G: Wireless Call Drop Rate(%), NSA DC SgNB-triggered Abnormal Release Rate of SgNBs(%)
- Toggle
4G: Handover Success Rate(%)
5G: Handover Success Rate(%)
- Experience
4G: Uplink User Experience Average Rate(Mbps), Downlink User Experience Average Rate(Mbps), Uplink Experience Rate(Mbps), Downlink Experience Rate(Mbps)
5G: Uplink User Average Rate(Mbps), Downlink User Average Rate(Mbps)
- Business volume
4G: VoLTE Voice Traffic Volume(erl), 4G Uplink Traffic Volume(GB), 4G Downlink Traffic Volume(GB), 4G Total Traffic Volume(GB)
5G: PDCP Uplink Traffic Volume(GB), PDCP Downlink Traffic Volume(GB), PDCP Total Traffic Volume(GB)
- Load
4G: Average Number of Users in a Cell, Maximum Number of Users in a Cell, Average Number of Activated Users, Maximum Number of Activated Users, Uplink PRB Usage(%), Downlink PRB Usage(%), CCE Usage(%)
5G: Average Number of RRC Users, Maximum Number of RRC Users, Average Number of Activated Users, Maximum Number of Activated Users, Average Uplink PRB Usage(%), Average Downlink PRB Usage(%), PDCCH CCE Usage(%)
- Interference
4G: Average Uplink Interference(dBm)
5G: Average Uplink Interference(dBm)
- Packet loss
5G: Downlink Packet Loss Rate at the RLC Layer of a Cell(%)
If you want to query a theme, you need to select the corresponding counters based on the theme and RAT to be queried and fill in the parameter list.
### Network RAT
If no RAT is specified, some counters are strongly bound to RATs. Therefore, you can use counters to map RATs.
The following counters are unique to 4G:
VoLTE Access Success Rate(%), VoLTE Call Drop Rate(%), VoLTE Voice Traffic Volume(erl), 4G Uplink Traffic Volume(GB), 4G Downlink Traffic Volume(GB), 4G Total Traffic Volume(GB), Uplink User Experience Average Rate(Mbps), Downlink User Experience Average Rate(Mbps), Uplink Experience Rate(Mbps), Downlink Experience Rate(Mbps), Average Number of Users in a Cell, Maximum Number of Users in a Cell, Uplink PRB Usage(%), Downlink PRB Usage(%), CCE Usage(%), 4G Percentage of Poor Voice Quality
The following counters are unique to 5G:
NSA DC SgNB Add Success Rate(%), NSA DC SgNB-triggered Abnormal Release Rate of SgNBs(%), PDCP Uplink Traffic Volume(GB), PDCP Downlink Traffic Volume(GB), PDCP Total Traffic Volume(GB), Uplink User Average Rate(Mbps), Downlink User Average Rate(Mbps), Downlink Packet Loss Rate at the RLC Layer of a Cell(%), Average Uplink PRB Usage(%), Average Downlink PRB Usage(%), PDCCH CCE Usage(%),Average Number of RRC Users, Maximum Number of RRC Users, 5G Percentage of Poor Voice Quality
### Constraints
If no RAT is specified, you need to determine the RAT based on the counters. The corresponding RAT is selected only when the counters meet the preceding mapping requirements.

The formula for converting the unit between dBm and W is as follows: dBm = 10 lg (power value/1 mW)

question:
你是一个电信领域的参数提取智能体，负责从**当前参数列表**中提取并返回所需的工具参数。你需要结合**上下文**和**经验知识**，确保所提取的参数准确无误。

## [任务要求]
1. 根据**当前参数列表**中的可选/必选说明字段，结合**经验知识**、**用户问题**、**上下文**和**当前节点描述**，提取当前所需的参数，**上下文**和**当前节点描述**可能为空。
2. **参数值要求**：确保提取的参数值完全符合其类型要求和取值范围；参数值必须直接来自**上下文**，或可从已明确提到的信息中得出的必然结论，不允许通过推测得出。
3. 以JSON格式返回所有提取的参数。

## [输入]
### <当前参数列表>
time:
   description: time是一个字符串字段，用于解析用户输入的时间信息，并生成一个表示时间范围的字符串，如[开始时间, 结束时间]。如果用户输入包括具体的日期和时间，如YYYY年MM月DD日hh时mm分ss秒，time将直接使用这个具体时间点，格式为[YYYY-MM-DD hh:mm:ss, YYYY-MM-DD hh:mm:ss]。但是，当用户输入的是模糊时间，如今天上午、上周、上个月，time将自动扩展为对应的时间范围，如[今天 00:00:00, 今天 11:59:59]、[上周1 00:00:00, 上周7 23:59:59]、[上个月01 00:00:00, 上个月31 23:59:59]。如果用户输入的时间信息缺失“开始时间”，开始时间将默认为“今天 00:00:00”；如果缺失“结束时间”，结束时间将默认为“现在”。
   type: string
   required: true
timeDim:
   description: 查询时间维度，支持小时：hour；天：day；周：week；月：month。当用户指定查询的时间维度时，输入为对应的维度，比如”小时维度的值“表示timeDim为”小时“，”天维度的值“表示timeDim为”天“，比如”周维度的值“表示timeDim为”周“，”月维度的值“表示timeDim为”月“，”日均“表示timeDim为”day“，”周均“表示timeDim为”week“，”月均“表示timeDim为”month“，timeDim默认值为day。
   type: string
   required: true
   enum:
     - hour
     - day
     - week
     - month
rat:
   description: 网络制式，可能的取值包括"4G"、"5G"。用户问题中未明确指定时，可以从查询指标上判断，比如查询VoLTE接通率时，网络制式为4G，因为VoLTE是4G网络的特性。
   type: string
   required: true
object:
   description: 查询对象，可以是小区或对象组。对象组有时对应一个行政区，如杭州市、萧山区、淳安县。
   type: string
   required: true
counters:
   description: 查询指标列表，支持一个或多个。如果用户按专题查询，则指标列表取值为专题包含的所有指标。如用户查询4G网络的接通专题，指标列表取值为["无线接通率(%)", "VOLTE接通率(%)"]。
   type: array
   required: true
   items:
     type: string

## [经验知识]

### 专题列表
指标可以按照专题和知识进行分类，如下是各专题分类名称和4G/5G下对应的指标：
- 接通
4G：无线接通率(%)，VOLTE接通率(%)
5G：无线接通率(%)，NSA DC辅站添加成功率(%)
- 掉话
4G：无线掉线率(%)，VOLTE掉话率(%)
5G：无线掉线率(%)，NSA DC SgNB触发的辅站异常释放率(%)
- 切换
4G：切换成功率(%)
5G：切换成功率(%)
- 体验
4G：上行用户体验平均速率(Mbps)，下行用户体验平均速率(Mbps)，上行体验速率(Mbps)，下行体验速率(Mbps)
5G：上行用户平均速率(Mbps)，下行用户平均速率(Mbps)
- 业务量
4G：VOLTE语音话务量(erl)，4G上行流量(GB)，4G下行流量(GB)，4G总流量(GB)
5G：PDCP上行流量(GB)，PDCP下行流量(GB)，PDCP总流量(GB)
- 负载
4G：小区内的平均用户数，小区内的最大用户数，平均激活用户数，最大激活用户数，上行PRB利用率(%)，下行PRB利用率(%)，CCE利用率(%)
5G：RRC平均用户数，RRC最大用户数，平均激活用户数，最大激活用户数，上行PRB平均利用率(%)，下行PRB平均利用率(%)，PDCCH CCE利用率(%)
- 干扰
4G：上行平均干扰(dBm)
5G：上行平均干扰(dBm)
- 丢包
5G：小区RLC层下行丢包率(%)
如果用户是对专题进行查询，需要根据查询的专题和制式选择对应的指标填入参数列表
####指标列表

PDCP上行流量(GB), PDCP下行流量(GB), PDCP总流量(GB), RRC平均用户数, RRC最大用户数, 平均激活用户数, 最大激活用户数, 无线接通率(%), 无线接通率-剔除合理原因导致的失败(%), 无线掉线率(%), 切换成功率(%), 上行PRB平均利用率(%), 下行PRB平均利用率(%), PDCCH CCE利用率(%), 上行用户平均速率(Mbps), 下行用户平均速率(Mbps), 上行平均干扰(dBm), NSA DC辅站添加成功率(%), NSA DC SgNB触发的辅站异常释放率(%), 小区RLC层下行丢包率(%), 小区内的平均用户数, 小区内的最大用户数, 上行PRB利用率(%), 下行PRB利用率(%), 上行平均干扰(dBm), 上行用户体验平均速率(Mbps), 下行用户体验平均速率(Mbps), 上行体验速率(Mbps), 下行体验速率(Mbps), VOLTE语音话务量(erl), VOLTE接通率(%), VOLTE掉话率(%), 4G上行流量(GB), 4G下行流量(GB), 4G总流量(GB), CCE利用率(%), 切换成功率(%), 4G语音感知质差比例, 5G语音感知质差比例
###网络制式
如果用户没有指定制式时，由于某些指标和制式强绑定，可以通过指标进行制式的映射。
如下指标是4G独有：
VOLTE接通率(%)，VOLTE掉话率(%)，VOLTE语音话务量(erl)，4G上行流量(GB)，4G下行流量(GB)，4G总流量(GB)
如下指标是5G独有：
NSA DC辅站添加成功率(%)，NSA DC SgNB触发的辅站异常释放率(%)，PDCP上行流量(GB)，PDCP下行流量(GB)，PDCP总流量(GB)
### 约束
当用户没有指定制式时才需要通过指标进行制式判断，仅当指标满足上述映射时才选择对应的制式

"test1_lagtest"."amount", CAST(LAG("test1_lagtest"."amount", 7) AS NUMERIC) OVER 
(PARTITION BY "test1_lagtest"."modified" ORDER BY "test1_lagtest"."modified" ASC) 
AS "w" FROM "test1_lagtest"
I believe this fails as the CAST() statement ends after LAG whereas it should be around the whole statement up until "w"
This only applies where the lagged field is a DecimalField e.g.
w = Window(expression=Lag('data',7), partition_by=[F('modified')], order_by=F('modified').asc())
works correctly.
I can override it by adding output_field=FloatField() to the Lag function e.g.
w = Window(expression=Lag('amount',7,output_field=FloatField()), partition_by=[F('modified')], order_by=F('modified').asc())

章节:卷二
方剂组成:雄黄（水飞）四分辰砂（水飞）二钱火消四分麝香一分金箔五张
主治:一切瘟疫伤寒，身热口渴，头疼身痛。
用法:上为极细末，瓷瓶收贮。男左女右，点大眼角内。盖被，登时出汗而愈。
资料7:
方剂名:发表丸
书籍名:《寿世保元》
章节:卷二
方剂组成:甘草麻黄升麻葛根各四两苍术二两
主治:伤寒无汗，头疼发热，身痛口干。
用法:上为细末，炼蜜为丸，如皂子大。每服一丸，生绿豆汤送下。如过三日外，加黄酒一钟，再加一丸。
资料8:
方剂名:桂枝散
书籍名:《医方类聚》
章节:卷五十三引
方剂组成:桂枝一两赤芍药一两甘草半两（炙）
功效:发汗。
主治:四时伤寒并时气。
用法:上为散。每服四钱，以水一中盏，加生姜半分，大枣三枚，煎至五分，去滓热服，不拘时候。此方自霜降至春分宜用。
资料9:
方剂名:解肌出汗方
书籍名:《圣惠》
章节:卷十
方剂组成:葛根一两（剉）石膏二两麻黄一两（去根节）黄芩半两赤芍药半两桂心半两甘草半两（炙微赤，剉）
主治:伤寒热毒未解，欲生豌豆疮，发热疼痛。
用法:上为细散。每服二钱，不拘时候以暖酒调下，并三服。衣盖取汗。
资料10:
方剂名:升麻发表汤
书籍名:《伤寒六书》
章节:卷四
方剂组成:麻黄四分桂枝甘草各三分杏仁（去皮尖）白芷防风各八分升麻五分羌活川芎各一钱
禁忌:中病即止，不得多服，多则反加别病。有汗者勿用。
主治:冬月正伤寒，头痛发热恶寒，脊强，脉浮紧，无汗，头如斧劈，身如火炽者。
用法:水二钟，加生姜三片，葱白二茎，豆豉一撮煎之，热服取汗。宜厚被覆首。感寒甚重，服不作汗，宜再服二三剂。
资料11:
名称:解肌发汗散
描述:解肌发汗散，中医方剂名。出自《普济方》卷三六九。主治小儿伤寒发热。
出处:《普济方》卷三六九
主治:小儿伤寒发热。
资料12:
方剂名:取汗汤
书籍名:《普济方》
章节:卷三六八
方剂组成:麻黄三分（去节）射干甘草（炙）升麻?芍药贝母石膏（碎）各二分桂心一分杏仁（去皮）二十个
主治:小儿伤寒。
用法:上切。以水三升，煮至一升二合。儿强者三合，弱者二合。便令卧取汗，如人行十五里再服之。
资料13:
方剂名:疏邪实表汤
书籍名:《伤寒六书》
章节:卷三
方剂组成:白术赤芍各一钱桂枝三分防风川芎羌活各八分甘草二分
主治:冬月正伤风，头痛发热，恶寒背强，脉浮缓，自汗。
用法:水二钟，加生姜三片，大枣三枚（捶碎），加胶饴二匙煎之，温服。无汗不可服。
资料14:
方剂名:发表散
书籍名:《寿世保元》
章节:卷二
方剂组成:葛根二钱西芎一钱五分黄芩二钱甘草八分
主治:伤寒伤风，头疼发热，口干鼻涕，四时瘟疫流行。
用法:上剉一剂。加生姜三片，葱白三根，水煎。热服出汗。
资料15:
方剂名:浮萍散
书籍名:《幼幼新书》
章节:卷十四引郑愈方
方剂组成:浮萍麻黄京芎天麻各二钱
功效:出汗。
主治:小儿伤寒壮热。
用法:上为末。每服二钱，薄荷酒调下。覆令出汗。
资料16:
方剂名:发汗散
书籍名:《串雅内编》
章节:卷一
方剂组成:绿豆粉麻黄（去根节）甘草各等分
主治:感冒风寒。
用法:上为极细末。每服一钱，用无根水半茶杯调服。即时汗出自愈。
资料17:
方剂名:万金散
书籍名:《普济方》
章节:卷一五一
方剂组成:桔梗川芎前胡苍术枳壳蜀椒六两甘草三两
功效:解时气伤寒，和表里。
主治:时气伤寒。
用法:水煎服。每服三钱，水一盏半，加生姜五片，煎八分，热服。并进三服，汗出即愈。
资料18:
方剂名:八解散
书籍名:《杨氏家藏方》
章节:卷三
方剂组成:荆芥穗三两防风（去芦头）人参（去芦头）黄芩麻黄（去根节）肉桂（去粗皮）苍术（米泔水浸一宿）甘草（炙）各一两半
功效:解利。
主治:伤寒头痛发热，浑身拘急，四肢疼痛者。
用法:水煎服。每服五钱，水一盏半，加生姜三片，大枣一枚，淡豆豉三十粒，同煎至一盏，去滓温服。并进三服。汗出即愈。
资料19:
方剂名:实表汤
书籍名:《嵩崖尊生》
章节:卷十
方剂组成:桂枝赤芍甘草防风川芎羌活白术
主治:冬月伤风，有汗。
资料20:
方剂名:发表汤
书籍名:《点点经》
章节:卷二
方剂组成:穿甲三片钩藤川椒桂枝地肤子秦艽各二钱寸香三分肉桂一钱五分附子一钱虎骨一钱柑树叶四两
主治:酒伤经络，瘫痪不遂，周身不仁。
用法:水煎服。取汗禁风。

question:
You are an intelligent body of parameter extraction in the field of telecommunications, responsible for extracting and returning the required tool parameters from the **current parameter list**. You need to combine **context** and **experience knowledge** to ensure that the parameters extracted are accurate and error-free.

## [Task Requirements]
1. According to the optional/mandatory description fields in the **current parameter list**, combine **experience knowledge**, **user questions**, **context**, and **current node description** to extract the currently required parameters. **Context and current node description** may be empty.
2. **Parameter Value Requirements**: Ensure that the extracted parameter values fully meet their type requirements and value ranges; parameter values must directly come from the **context**, or they can be derived from clearly mentioned information, and are not allowed to be speculatively derived.
3. Return all extracted parameters in JSON format.

## [Input]
### <Current Parameter List>
time:
   description:  time is a string field used to parse the time information entered by the user and generate a string representing the time range, such as [start time, end time]. If the user input includes a specific date and time, such as YYYY-MM-DD hh:mm:ss, time will use this specific time point directly, the format is [YYYY-MM-DD hh:mm:ss, YYYY-MM-DD hh:mm:ss]. However, when the user input is vague time, such as this morning, last week, last month, time will automatically expand to the corresponding time range, such as [today 00:00:00, today 11:59:59], [last Monday 00:00:00, last Sunday 23:59:59], [last month 1 day 00:00:00, last month 31 day 23:59:59]. If the user input time information is missing the "start time", the default start time will be "today 00:00:00"; if it is missing the "end time", the end time will default to "now".

   required: true

   description: Query time dimension, support hour: hour; day: day; week: week; month: month. When the user specifies the query time dimension, the input is the corresponding dimension. For example, "the value of the hour dimension" means that timeDim is "hour", "the value of the day dimension" means that timeDim is "day", for example, "the value of the week dimension" means that timeDim is "week", "the value of the month dimension" means that timeDim is "month", "daily average" means that timeDim is "day", "weekly average" means that timeDim is "week", "monthly average" means that timeDim is "month", timeDim default value is day.
   type: string
   required: true
   enum:
     - hour
     - day
     - week
     - month
rat:
   description: Network system, possible values include "4G", "5G". When the user question does not specify it, it can be judged from the query indicator. For example, when querying VoLTE connection rate, the network system is 4G because VoLTE is a feature of the 4G network.
   type: string
   required: true
object:
   description: Query object, can be a cell or object group. The object group sometimes corresponds to an administrative region, such as Hangzhou, Xiaoshan, and Chun'an.
   type: string
   required: true
counters:
   description: Query indicator list, support one or more. If the user queries by topic, the indicator list value is all indicators included in the topic. For example, if the user queries the 4G network connection theme, the indicator list value is ["Radio Access Success Rate(%)", "VoLTE Access Success Rate(%)"]
   type: array
   required: true
   items:
     type: string
filterOperation: 
   description: Filter method, need to extract the comparison method according to the user's intention when filtering data, the value of filterOperation: 1. Filtering method, when the input is equal, filterOperation is "=", when the input is greater than, filterOperation is ">", when the input is less than, filterOperation is "<", when the input is greater than or equal to, filterOperation is ">=", when the input is less than or equal to, filterOperation is "<=", when the input is not equal to, filterOperation is "!=", 2. Filtering method, when the input is best, best, highest, filterOperation is "top", when the input is worst, lowest, least, filterOperation is "bottom"
   type: string
   required: true
filterValue:
   description: Filter value, when the input method is "=", ">", "<", you need to fill in specific values without showing units.    type: string

## [Experience Knowledge]
### Object group
Object groups include:
- HangZhou
- XiaoShan
- GongShu
### Theme List
KQIs/KPIs can be classified by topic and knowledge. The following table lists the name of each theme and the corresponding KQIs/KPIs under 4G/5G.
- Connect
4G: Radio Access Success Rate(%), VoLTE Access Success Rate(%)
5G: Radio Access Success Rate(%), NSA DC SgNB Add Success Rate(%)
- Call drop
4G: Wireless Call Drop Rate(%), VoLTE Call Drop Rate(%)
5G: Wireless Call Drop Rate(%), NSA DC SgNB-triggered Abnormal Release Rate of SgNBs(%)
- Toggle
4G: Handover Success Rate(%)
5G: Handover Success Rate(%)
- Experience
4G: Uplink User Experience Average Rate(Mbps), Downlink User Experience Average Rate(Mbps), Uplink Experience Rate(Mbps), Downlink Experience Rate(Mbps)
5G: Uplink User Average Rate(Mbps), Downlink User Average Rate(Mbps)
- Business volume
4G: VoLTE Voice Traffic Volume(erl), 4G Uplink Traffic Volume(GB), 4G Downlink Traffic Volume(GB), 4G Total Traffic Volume(GB)
5G: PDCP Uplink Traffic Volume(GB), PDCP Downlink Traffic Volume(GB), PDCP Total Traffic Volume(GB)
- Load
4G: Average Number of Users in a Cell, Maximum Number of Users in a Cell, Average Number of Activated Users, Maximum Number of Activated Users, Uplink PRB Usage(%), Downlink PRB Usage(%), CCE Usage(%)
5G: Average Number of RRC Users, Maximum Number of RRC Users, Average Number of Activated Users, Maximum Number of Activated Users, Average Uplink PRB Usage(%), Average Downlink PRB Usage(%), PDCCH CCE Usage(%)
- Interference
4G: Average Uplink Interference(dBm)
5G: Average Uplink Interference(dBm)
- Packet loss
5G: Downlink Packet Loss Rate at the RLC Layer of a Cell(%)
If you want to query a theme, you need to select the corresponding counters based on the theme and RAT to be queried and fill in the parameter list.
### Network RAT
If no RAT is specified, some counters are strongly bound to RATs. Therefore, you can use counters to map RATs.
The following counters are unique to 4G:
VoLTE Access Success Rate(%), VoLTE Call Drop Rate(%), VoLTE Voice Traffic Volume(erl), 4G Uplink Traffic Volume(GB), 4G Downlink Traffic Volume(GB), 4G Total Traffic Volume(GB), Uplink User Experience Average Rate(Mbps), Downlink User Experience Average Rate(Mbps), Uplink Experience Rate(Mbps), Downlink Experience Rate(Mbps), Average Number of Users in a Cell, Maximum Number of Users in a Cell, Uplink PRB Usage(%), Downlink PRB Usage(%), CCE Usage(%), 4G Percentage of Poor Voice Quality
The following counters are unique to 5G:
NSA DC SgNB Add Success Rate(%), NSA DC SgNB-triggered Abnormal Release Rate of SgNBs(%), PDCP Uplink Traffic Volume(GB), PDCP Downlink Traffic Volume(GB), PDCP Total Traffic Volume(GB), Uplink User Average Rate(Mbps), Downlink User Average Rate(Mbps), Downlink Packet Loss Rate at the RLC Layer of a Cell(%), Average Uplink PRB Usage(%), Average Downlink PRB Usage(%), PDCCH CCE Usage(%),Average Number of RRC Users, Maximum Number of RRC Users, 5G Percentage of Poor Voice Quality
### Constraints
If no RAT is specified, you need to determine the RAT based on the counters. The corresponding RAT is selected only when the counters meet the preceding mapping requirements.
### Level value unit
The formula for converting the unit between dBm and W is as follows: dBm = 10 lg (power value/1 mW)
pW: picowatt
nW: nanowatt
mW: milliwatt
W: watt
kW: kilowatt
MW: megawatt
1W=1000mW
1kW=1000W
1MW=1000000W=1000kW
1nW=0.000000001W
1pW=0.000000000001W

I have a 3D WCS with dimensions corresponding to space, space, and wavelength and what some might call a non-trivial PCij matrix that couples the spectral and spatial dimensions. I find that when I perform a world_to_pixel on the full (unsliced) WCS, I get back the expected result. However, when I perform that same world_to_pixel operation on a single wavelength slice (i.e. a 2D slice with dimensions corresponding to space, space), my world_to_pixel returns an erroneous result for one of the dimensions._x000D_
_x000D_
This issue was originally posted as sunpy/ndcube#529, but I've moved it here as it seems to be an issue with `SlicedLowLevelWCS` rather than anything specific to `ndcube`._x000D_
_x000D_

Doing the following `world_to_pixel` operation on the unsliced WCS works as expected by returning me the central pixel in space and first pixel in wavelength_x000D_
```python_x000D_
>>> pt = SkyCoord(Tx=0*u.arcsec, Ty=0*u.arcsec, frame=astropy.wcs.utils.wcs_to_celestial_frame(fits_wcs))_x000D_
>>> fits_wcs.world_to_pixel(pt, 1.05*u.angstrom)_x000D_
(array(49.5), array(12.), array(2.44249065e-15))_x000D_
```_x000D_
I would then expect that if I take the first slice (in wavelength of my cube and do a pixel_to_world on just the spatial coordinate from above, that I would get back the same first two components_x000D_
```python_x000D_
>>> ll_sliced_wcs = astropy.wcs.wcsapi.SlicedLowLevelWCS(fits_wcs, 0)_x000D_
>>> hl_sliced_wcs = astropy.wcs.wcsapi.HighLevelWCSWrapper(ll_sliced_wcs)_x000D_
>>> hl_sliced_wcs.world_to_pixel(pt)_x000D_
(array(1.81818182e+11), array(12.))_x000D_
```_x000D_
However, this is not the case. The first pixel entry is essentially infinite._x000D_

你的任务是提取<用户问题>中参数的值，以下是参数描述：
startTime:
  描述: startTime是一个表示用户输入的“开始时间”的字符串。如果用户的输入包含完整的日期和时间，例如“X年X月X日”，那么开始时间的格式将为“YYYY-MM-DD hh:mm:ss”。如果输入中没有具体日期，但包含相对时间，例如“今天早上”、“周三晚上8点”或“2天前”，开始时间的格式将为“XX hh:mm:ss”，其中“XX”是相对时间表达，如“今天”、“周三”或“2天前”。某一年的开始时间是该年1月1日00:00:00；某个月的开始时间是该月1日00:00:00；某一天的开始时间是当天的00:00:00；“早上”的开始时间是当天的00:00:00；“下午”的开始时间是当天的12:00:00；“晚上”的开始时间是当天的18:00:00。若用户问题中没有出现相关时间描述，开始时间默认为""。
  类型: string
endTime:
  描述: endTime是一个表示用户输入的“结束时间”的字符串。如果用户的输入包含完整的日期和时间，例如“X年X月X日”，那么结束时间的格式为“YYYY-MM-DD hh:mm:ss”。如果输入中没有具体日期，但包含相对日期，例如“今天早上”或“周三晚上8点”，结束时间的格式将为“XX hh:mm:ss”，其中“XX”表示相对日期，如“今天”或“周三”。如果用户的输入中包含指示过去时间范围的短语，如“最近”、“过去”、“之前”或“上次”，结束时间将为“现在（now）”。某一年的结束时间为该年12月31日23:59:59；某个月的结束时间为该月的最后一天23:59:59；某一天的结束时间为当天的23:59:59；“早上”的结束时间为当天的11:59:59；“下午”的结束时间为当天的17:59:59；“晚上”的结束时间为当天的23:59:59。若用户问题中没有出现相关时间描述，开始时间默认为""。
  类型: string
regionName:
  描述: regionName是一个表示用户输入的“行政区域”或“地点位置”的字符串，普遍由一组或多组数字、汉字或英文字母组成，组成部分之间通过“-”等符号连接。
  类型: string

  描述: 排序方式，可以支持升序和降序。当用户问题表示查询网络质量差的信息时，sortType为asc，表示升序，网络质量差同义词包括“强度不好”、“信号不佳”、“网体验差”、“体验差”等关键词。当用户问题表示查询网络质量好的信息时，sortType为desc，表示降序，网络质量好同义词包括“强度高”、“信号好”、“网速快”、“体验好”等关键词。
  类型: string
  可选项列表: [desc, asc]
limit:
  描述: limit表示返回的查询结果的数量
  类型: integer
  默认值: 10
aggregationType:
  描述: 汇聚类型。aggregationType为last，表示最新值；aggregationType为max，表示最大值；aggregationType为min，表示最小值；aggregationType为average，表示平均值；aggregationType为sum，表示累计值。
  类型: string
  可选项列表: [last, max, min, average, sum]
queryType:
  类型: string
  描述: 查询类型。目前只支持聚合查询，queryType为aggregation。

你是核心网运维工程师，你的任务参考<示例>，将给定的<处理步骤>转换成<step格式>。

<示例>
<处理步骤>：
1.在UNC外联口PING对端外联口IP。
2.在“MML命令行-UEG”窗口上使用命令DSP PFCPASSOC，QUERYTYPE选择ALL，查看本端与对端地址信息是否与全网规划的SMF及UPF地址相对应。
是 => 3
否 => 修改地址信息后，等待10s左右观察该告警是否消失。如果告警仍存在则执行步骤1
3.联系对端设备运维工程师，分析对端设备是否故障。
是 => 修复对端设备故障后，则等待10s左右观察该告警是否消失。
否 => 4
4.请收集告警信息、日志信息和配置信息，并联系华为技术支持处理。

<step格式>：
[
 {
    "step": "1",
    "description": "在UNC外联口PING对端外联口IP。"
  },
  {
    "step": "2",
    "description": "在\"MML命令行-UEG\"窗口上使用命令DSP PFCPASSOC，QUERYTYPE选择ALL，查看本端与对端地址信息是否与全网规划的SMF及UPF地址相对应。",
    "choice": [
      {
        "condition": "是",
        "nextStep": "3"

    ]
  },
  {
    "step": "3",
    "description": "联系对端设备运维工程师，分析对端设备是否故障。",
    "choice": [

        "nextStep": "修复对端设备故障后，则等待10s左右观察该告警是否消失。"

      {

        "nextStep": "4"
      }

<处理步骤>
1. 查询网关是否处于正常注册过程中。
执行DSP VMGW命令，查看网关当前的状态是否为“等待建链态”、“等待注册态”或“业务态”。

是=>步骤 2
否=>步骤 3

2. 查询网关注册成功后告警是否恢复。
执行DSP VMGW命令，查看网关当前的状态是否为“业务态”。当网关处于“业务态”时，该告警是否恢复。

是，本故障为网关未正常注册=>步骤 28
否=>步骤 3

3. 检查两端H.248参数配置是否一致。

a. 执行LST H248LNK命令，记录以下参数：

本地主IP地址
本地端口号
目的主IP地址
目的端口号
传输协议类型

如果“传输协议类型”为M3UA或MTP3B，则记录以下参数：

源信令点编码
目的信令点编码

b. 执行LST H248PARA命令，记录以下参数：

H248协议编解码类型
HMAC消息摘要类型

c. 联系MGC设备维护人员，判断以上记录的参数是否与MGC配置一致。


是=>步骤 8
否=>步骤 4

4. 根据网络设计，判断是否需要MGW修改配置。
是=>步骤 5
否=>步骤 7

5. 删除错误的配置。

question:
你是一个电信领域的参数提取智能体，负责从**当前参数列表**中提取并返回所需的工具参数。你需要结合**上下文**和**经验知识**，确保所提取的参数准确无误。

## [任务要求]
1. 根据**当前参数列表**中的可选/必选说明字段，结合**经验知识**、**用户问题**、**上下文**和**当前节点描述**，提取当前所需的参数，**上下文**和**当前节点描述**可能为空。
2. **参数值要求**：确保提取的参数值完全符合其类型要求和取值范围；参数值必须直接来自**上下文**，或可从已明确提到的信息中得出的必然结论，不允许通过推测得出。
3. 以JSON格式返回所有提取的参数。

## [输入]
### <当前参数列表>
time:
   description: time是一个字符串字段，用于解析用户输入的时间信息，并生成一个表示时间范围的字符串，如[开始时间, 结束时间]。如果用户输入包括具体的日期和时间，如YYYY年MM月DD日hh时mm分ss秒，time将直接使用这个具体时间点，格式为[YYYY-MM-DD hh:mm:ss, YYYY-MM-DD hh:mm:ss]。但是，当用户输入的是模糊时间，如今天上午、上周、上个月，time将自动扩展为对应的时间范围，如[今天 00:00:00, 今天 11:59:59]、[上周1 00:00:00, 上周7 23:59:59]、[上个月01 00:00:00, 上个月31 23:59:59]。如果用户输入的时间信息缺失“开始时间”，开始时间将默认为“今天 00:00:00”；如果缺失“结束时间”，结束时间将默认为“现在”。
   type: string
   required: true
timeDim:
   description: 查询时间维度，支持小时：hour；天：day；周：week；月：month。当用户指定查询的时间维度时，输入为对应的维度，比如”小时维度的值“表示timeDim为”小时“，”天维度的值“表示timeDim为”天“，比如”周维度的值“表示timeDim为”周“，”月维度的值“表示timeDim为”月“，”日均“表示timeDim为”day“，”周均“表示timeDim为”week“，”月均“表示timeDim为”month“，timeDim默认值为day。
   type: string
   required: true
   enum:
     - hour
     - day
     - week
     - month
rat:
   description: 网络制式，可能的取值包括"4G"、"5G"。用户问题中未明确指定时，可以从查询指标上判断，比如查询VoLTE接通率时，网络制式为4G，因为VoLTE是4G网络的特性。
   type: string

### 专题列表
指标可以按照专题和知识进行分类，如下是各专题分类名称和4G/5G下对应的指标：
- 接通
4G：无线接通率(%)，VOLTE接通率(%)
5G：无线接通率(%)，NSA DC辅站添加成功率(%)
- 掉话
4G：无线掉线率(%)，VOLTE掉话率(%)
5G：无线掉线率(%)，NSA DC SgNB触发的辅站异常释放率(%)
- 切换
4G：切换成功率(%)
5G：切换成功率(%)
- 体验
4G：上行用户体验平均速率(Mbps)，下行用户体验平均速率(Mbps)，上行体验速率(Mbps)，下行体验速率(Mbps)
5G：上行用户平均速率(Mbps)，下行用户平均速率(Mbps)
- 业务量
4G：VOLTE语音话务量(erl)，4G上行流量(GB)，4G下行流量(GB)，4G总流量(GB)
5G：PDCP上行流量(GB)，PDCP下行流量(GB)，PDCP总流量(GB)
- 负载
4G：小区内的平均用户数，小区内的最大用户数，平均激活用户数，最大激活用户数，上行PRB利用率(%)，下行PRB利用率(%)，CCE利用率(%)
5G：RRC平均用户数，RRC最大用户数，平均激活用户数，最大激活用户数，上行PRB平均利用率(%)，下行PRB平均利用率(%)，PDCCH CCE利用率(%)
- 干扰
4G：上行平均干扰(dBm)
5G：上行平均干扰(dBm)
- 丢包
5G：小区RLC层下行丢包率(%)
如果用户是对专题进行查询，需要根据查询的专题和制式选择对应的指标填入参数列表

###网络制式
如果用户没有指定制式时，由于某些指标和制式强绑定，可以通过指标进行制式的映射。
如下指标是4G独有：
VOLTE接通率(%)，VOLTE掉话率(%)，VOLTE语音话务量(erl)，4G上行流量(GB)，4G下行流量(GB)，4G总流量(GB)
如下指标是5G独有：
NSA DC辅站添加成功率(%)，NSA DC SgNB触发的辅站异常释放率(%)，PDCP上行流量(GB)，PDCP下行流量(GB)，PDCP总流量(GB)

>>> pt = SkyCoord(Tx=0*u.arcsec, Ty=0*u.arcsec, frame=astropy.wcs.utils.wcs_to_celestial_frame(fits_wcs))_x000D_
>>> fits_wcs.world_to_pixel(pt, 1.05*u.angstrom)_x000D_
(array(49.5), array(12.), array(2.44249065e-15))_x000D_
```_x000D_
I would then expect that if I take the first slice (in wavelength of my cube and do a pixel_to_world on just the spatial coordinate from above, that I would get back the same first two components_x000D_
```python_x000D_
>>> ll_sliced_wcs = astropy.wcs.wcsapi.SlicedLowLevelWCS(fits_wcs, 0)_x000D_
>>> hl_sliced_wcs = astropy.wcs.wcsapi.HighLevelWCSWrapper(ll_sliced_wcs)_x000D_
>>> hl_sliced_wcs.world_to_pixel(pt)_x000D_
(array(1.81818182e+11), array(12.))_x000D_
```_x000D_
However, this is not the case. The first pixel entry is essentially infinite._x000D_
_x000D_

```python_x000D_
>>> px,py,pz = fits_wcs.world_to_pixel(pt, 1.05*u.Angstrom)_x000D_
>>> fits_wcs.pixel_to_world(px, py, pz)_x000D_
[<SkyCoord (Helioprojective: obstime=None, rsun=695700.0 km, observer=None): (Tx, Ty) in arcsec_x000D_
    (1.5467383e-27, 0.)>, <SpectralCoord 1.05e-10 m>]_x000D_
>>> hl_sliced_wcs.pixel_to_world(px, py)_x000D_
<SkyCoord (Helioprojective: obstime=None, rsun=695700.0 km, observer=None): (Tx, Ty) in arcsec_x000D_
    (1.5467383e-27, 0.)>_x000D_
```_x000D_

Yes: Go to 3.

id: 38747_电信工具调用-参数提取-实参提取-提取后计算_12494
question:
You are a parameter extraction intelligent agent in the field of telecommunications, responsible for extracting and returning the necessary tool parameters from the **current parameter list**. You need to combine **context** and **knowledge** to ensure that the parameters extracted are accurate.

## [Task Requirements]
1. Based on the optional/mandatory explanation field in the **current parameter list**, combine **knowledge**, **user questions**, **context**, and **current node description** to extract the needed parameters for now; **context** and **current node description** could be empty.
2. **Parameter Value Requirements**: Ensure that the extracted parameter values completely meet their type requirements and range of values; parameter values must come directly from the **context**, or must be the inevitable conclusion drawn from the clearly mentioned information, and cannot be attained through speculation.
3. Return all extracted parameters in JSON format.

## [Input]
### <Current Parameter List>
time:
   description: time is a string field that is used to parse the user's input time information and generate a string that represents a range of time, such as [start time, end time]. If the user input includes specific date and time, such as YYYY-MM-DD hh:mm:ss, time will directly use this specific time, the format is [YYYY-MM-DD hh:mm:ss, YYYY-MM-DD hh:mm:ss]. However, when the user's input is vague time, such as this morning, last week, last month, time will automatically expand into the corresponding time range, such as [today 00:00:00, today 11:59:59], [last Monday 00:00:00, last Sunday 23:59:59], [last month 1st 00:00:00, last month 31st 23:59:59]. If the user's time input is missing "start time", the start time will default to "today 00:00:00"; if "end time" is missing, the end time will default to "now".
   type: string
   required: true
timeDim:
   description: Query time dimension, support hour; day; week; month. When the user specifies the time dimension of the query, the input is the corresponding dimension, such as "hourly dimension value" means that timeDim is "hour", "daily dimension value" means that timeDim is "day", "weekly dimension value" means that timeDim is "week", "monthly dimension value" means that timeDim is "month", "daily average" means that timeDim is "day", "weekly average" means that timeDim is "week", "monthly average" means that timeDim is "month", timeDim default value is day.
   type: string
   required: true
   enum:
     - hour
     - day
     - week
     - month
rat:
   description: Network standard, possible values include "4G", "5G". When the user's question does not specify, it can be judged from the query index, such as when querying the VoLTE connection rate, the network standard is 4G, because VoLTE is a feature of 4G network.
   type: string
   required: true
object:
   description: Query object, can be cell or object group. Object group sometimes corresponds to an administrative region, such as Hangzhou, Xiaoshan, and Chun'an.
   type: string
   required: true
counters:
   description: Query index list, supports one or more. If the user queries by subject, then the index list takes the value of all indexes contained in the subject. If the user queries the connection topic of 4G network, the index list takes the values of ["Radio Access Success Rate(%)", "VoLTE Access Success Rate(%)"]
   type: array
   required: true
   items:
     type: string
filterOperation: 
   description: Filter mode, it is necessary to extract the comparison mode according to user's intention during data filtering, filterOperation values:1. Filter mode, when the input is equal, filterOperation is "=", when the input is greater than, filterOperation is ">", when the input is lesser, filterOperation is "<", when the input is greater than or equal to, filterOperation is ">=", when the input is lesser than or equal to, filterOperation is "<=", when the input is not equal to, filterOperation is "!=",2. Filter mode, when the input is best, optimal or highest, filterOperation is "top", when the input is worst, lowest or least, filterOperation is "bottom"
   type: string
   required: true
filterValue:
   description: Filtering value, when entering mode is "=", ">", "<", a specific value without showing unit needs to be filled, the unit of this value needs to be consistent with counters field value, when the unit of value extracted from context is not consistent, unit conversion is required, for example: rate unit conversion formula: 1MBps=8Mb/s, 1MB/s=1024KB/s.
   type: string
   required: true

## [Knowledge]
### Object group
Object groups include:
- HangZhou
- XiaoShan
- GongShu
### Theme List
KQIs/KPIs can be classified by topic and knowledge. The following table lists the name of each theme and the corresponding KQIs/KPIs under 4G/5G.
- Connect
4G: Radio Access Success Rate(%), VoLTE Access Success Rate(%)
5G: Radio Access Success Rate(%), NSA DC SgNB Add Success Rate(%)
- Call drop
4G: Wireless Call Drop Rate(%), VoLTE Call Drop Rate(%)
5G: Wireless Call Drop Rate(%), NSA DC SgNB-triggered Abnormal Release Rate of SgNBs(%)
- Toggle
4G: Handover Success Rate(%)
5G: Handover Success Rate(%)
- Experience
4G: Uplink User Experience Average Rate(Mbps), Downlink User Experience Average Rate(Mbps), Uplink Experience Rate(Mbps), Downlink Experience Rate(Mbps)
5G: Uplink User Average Rate(Mbps), Downlink User Average Rate(Mbps)
- Business volume
4G: VoLTE Voice Traffic Volume(erl), 4G Uplink Traffic Volume(GB), 4G Downlink Traffic Volume(GB), 4G Total Traffic Volume(GB)

You are an intelligent body of parameter extraction in the field of telecommunications, responsible for extracting and returning the required tool parameters from the **current parameter list**. You need to combine **context** and **experience knowledge** to ensure that the parameters extracted are accurate and error-free.

## [Task Requirements]
1. According to the optional/mandatory description fields in the **current parameter list**, combine **experience knowledge**, **user questions**, **context**, and **current node description** to extract the currently required parameters. **Context and current node description** may be empty.
2. **Parameter Value Requirements**: Ensure that the extracted parameter values fully meet their type requirements and value ranges; parameter values must directly come from the **context**, or they can be derived from clearly mentioned information, and are not allowed to be speculatively derived.
3. Return all extracted parameters in JSON format.

## [Input]
### <Current Parameter List>
time:
   description:  time is a string field used to parse the time information entered by the user and generate a string representing the time range, such as [start time, end time]. If the user input includes a specific date and time, such as YYYY-MM-DD hh:mm:ss, time will use this specific time point directly, the format is [YYYY-MM-DD hh:mm:ss, YYYY-MM-DD hh:mm:ss]. However, when the user input is vague time, such as this morning, last week, last month, time will automatically expand to the corresponding time range, such as [today 00:00:00, today 11:59:59], [last Monday 00:00:00, last Sunday 23:59:59], [last month 1 day 00:00:00, last month 31 day 23:59:59]. If the user input time information is missing the "start time", the default start time will be "today 00:00:00"; if it is missing the "end time", the end time will default to "now".
   type: string
   required: true
timeDim:
   description: Query time dimension, support hour: hour; day: day; week: week; month: month. When the user specifies the query time dimension, the input is the corresponding dimension. For example, "the value of the hour dimension" means that timeDim is "hour", "the value of the day dimension" means that timeDim is "day", for example, "the value of the week dimension" means that timeDim is "week", "the value of the month dimension" means that timeDim is "month", "daily average" means that timeDim is "day", "weekly average" means that timeDim is "week", "monthly average" means that timeDim is "month", timeDim default value is day.
   type: string
   required: true
   enum:
     - hour
     - day
     - week
     - month
rat:
   description: Network system, possible values include "4G", "5G". When the user question does not specify it, it can be judged from the query indicator. For example, when querying VoLTE connection rate, the network system is 4G because VoLTE is a feature of the 4G network.
   type: string
   required: true
object:
   description: Query object, can be a cell or object group. The object group sometimes corresponds to an administrative region, such as Hangzhou, Xiaoshan, and Chun'an.
   type: string
   required: true
counters:
   description: Query indicator list, support one or more. If the user queries by topic, the indicator list value is all indicators included in the topic. For example, if the user queries the 4G network connection theme, the indicator list value is ["Radio Access Success Rate(%)", "VoLTE Access Success Rate(%)"]
   type: array
   required: true
   items:
     type: string
filterOperation: 
   description: Filter method, need to extract the comparison method according to the user's intention when filtering data, the value of filterOperation: 1. Filtering method, when the input is equal, filterOperation is "=", when the input is greater than, filterOperation is ">", when the input is less than, filterOperation is "<", when the input is greater than or equal to, filterOperation is ">=", when the input is less than or equal to, filterOperation is "<=", when the input is not equal to, filterOperation is "!=", 2.    type: string
   required: true
filterValue:
   description: Filter value, when the input method is "=", ">", "<", you need to fill in specific values without showing units.    type: string
   required: true

## [Experience Knowledge]
### Object group
Object groups include:
- HangZhou
- XiaoShan
- GongShu
### Theme List
KQIs/KPIs can be classified by topic and knowledge. The following table lists the name of each theme and the corresponding KQIs/KPIs under 4G/5G.
- Connect
4G: Radio Access Success Rate(%), VoLTE Access Success Rate(%)
5G: Radio Access Success Rate(%), NSA DC SgNB Add Success Rate(%)
- Call drop
4G: Wireless Call Drop Rate(%), VoLTE Call Drop Rate(%)
5G: Wireless Call Drop Rate(%), NSA DC SgNB-triggered Abnormal Release Rate of SgNBs(%)
- Toggle
4G: Handover Success Rate(%)
5G: Handover Success Rate(%)
- Experience
4G: Uplink User Experience Average Rate(Mbps), Downlink User Experience Average Rate(Mbps), Uplink Experience Rate(Mbps), Downlink Experience Rate(Mbps)
5G: Uplink User Average Rate(Mbps), Downlink User Average Rate(Mbps)
- Business volume
4G: VoLTE Voice Traffic Volume(erl), 4G Uplink Traffic Volume(GB), 4G Downlink Traffic Volume(GB), 4G Total Traffic Volume(GB)
5G: PDCP Uplink Traffic Volume(GB), PDCP Downlink Traffic Volume(GB), PDCP Total Traffic Volume(GB)
- Load
4G: Average Number of Users in a Cell, Maximum Number of Users in a Cell, Average Number of Activated Users, Maximum Number of Activated Users, Uplink PRB Usage(%), Downlink PRB Usage(%), CCE Usage(%)
5G: Average Number of RRC Users, Maximum Number of RRC Users, Average Number of Activated Users, Maximum Number of Activated Users, Average Uplink PRB Usage(%), Average Downlink PRB Usage(%), PDCCH CCE Usage(%)
- Interference
4G: Average Uplink Interference(dBm)
5G: Average Uplink Interference(dBm)
- Packet loss
5G: Downlink Packet Loss Rate at the RLC Layer of a Cell(%)
If you want to query a theme, you need to select the corresponding counters based on the theme and RAT to be queried and fill in the parameter list.
### Network RAT
If no RAT is specified, some counters are strongly bound to RATs. Therefore, you can use counters to map RATs.
The following counters are unique to 4G:
VoLTE Access Success Rate(%), VoLTE Call Drop Rate(%), VoLTE Voice Traffic Volume(erl), 4G Uplink Traffic Volume(GB), 4G Downlink Traffic Volume(GB), 4G Total Traffic Volume(GB), Uplink User Experience Average Rate(Mbps), Downlink User Experience Average Rate(Mbps), Uplink Experience Rate(Mbps), Downlink Experience Rate(Mbps), Average Number of Users in a Cell, Maximum Number of Users in a Cell, Uplink PRB Usage(%), Downlink PRB Usage(%), CCE Usage(%), 4G Percentage of Poor Voice Quality
The following counters are unique to 5G:
NSA DC SgNB Add Success Rate(%), NSA DC SgNB-triggered Abnormal Release Rate of SgNBs(%), PDCP Uplink Traffic Volume(GB), PDCP Downlink Traffic Volume(GB), PDCP Total Traffic Volume(GB), Uplink User Average Rate(Mbps), Downlink User Average Rate(Mbps), Downlink Packet Loss Rate at the RLC Layer of a Cell(%), Average Uplink PRB Usage(%), Average Downlink PRB Usage(%), PDCCH CCE Usage(%),Average Number of RRC Users, Maximum Number of RRC Users, 5G Percentage of Poor Voice Quality
### Constraints
If no RAT is specified, you need to determine the RAT based on the counters. The corresponding RAT is selected only when the counters meet the preceding mapping requirements.
### Level value unit
The formula for converting the unit between dBm and W is as follows: dBm = 10 lg (power value/1 mW)
pW: picowatt
nW: nanowatt
mW: milliwatt
W: watt
kW: kilowatt
MW: megawatt
1W=1000mW
1kW=1000W
1MW=1000000W=1000kW
1nW=0.000000001W
1pW=0.000000000001W

question:
你是一个电信领域的参数提取智能体，负责从**当前参数列表**中提取并返回所需的工具参数。你需要结合**上下文**和**经验知识**，确保所提取的参数准确无误。

## [任务要求]
1. 根据**当前参数列表**中的可选/必选说明字段，结合**经验知识**、**用户问题**、**上下文**和**当前节点描述**，提取当前所需的参数，**上下文**和**当前节点描述**可能为空。
2. **参数值要求**：确保提取的参数值完全符合其类型要求和取值范围；参数值必须直接来自**上下文**，或可从已明确提到的信息中得出的必然结论，不允许通过推测得出。
3. 以JSON格式返回所有提取的参数。

## [输入]
### <当前参数列表>
time:
   description: time是一个字符串字段，用于解析用户输入的时间信息，并生成一个表示时间范围的字符串，如[开始时间, 结束时间]。如果用户输入包括具体的日期和时间，如YYYY年MM月DD日hh时mm分ss秒，time将直接使用这个具体时间点，格式为[YYYY-MM-DD hh:mm:ss, YYYY-MM-DD hh:mm:ss]。但是，当用户输入的是模糊时间，如今天上午、上周、上个月，time将自动扩展为对应的时间范围，如[今天 00:00:00, 今天 11:59:59]、[上周1 00:00:00, 上周7 23:59:59]、[上个月01 00:00:00, 上个月31 23:59:59]。如果用户输入的时间信息缺失“开始时间”，开始时间将默认为“今天 00:00:00”；如果缺失“结束时间”，结束时间将默认为“现在”。
   type: string
   required: true
timeDim:
   description: 查询时间维度，支持小时：hour；天：day；周：week；月：month。当用户指定查询的时间维度时，输入为对应的维度，比如”小时维度的值“表示timeDim为”小时“，”天维度的值“表示timeDim为”天“，比如”周维度的值“表示timeDim为”周“，”月维度的值“表示timeDim为”月“，”日均“表示timeDim为”day“，”周均“表示timeDim为”week“，”月均“表示timeDim为”month“，timeDim默认值为day。
   type: string
   required: true
   enum:
     - hour
     - day
     - week
     - month
rat:
   description: 网络制式，可能的取值包括"4G"、"5G"。用户问题中未明确指定时，可以从查询指标上判断，比如查询VoLTE接通率时，网络制式为4G，因为VoLTE是4G网络的特性。
   type: string
   required: true
object:
   description: 查询对象，可以是小区或对象组。对象组有时对应一个行政区，如杭州市、萧山区、淳安县。
   type: string
   required: true
counters:
   description: 查询指标列表，支持一个或多个。如果用户按专题查询，则指标列表取值为专题包含的所有指标。如用户查询4G网络的接通专题，指标列表取值为["无线接通率(%)", "VOLTE接通率(%)"]。
   type: array
   required: true
   items:
     type: string

### 专题列表
指标可以按照专题和知识进行分类，如下是各专题分类名称和4G/5G下对应的指标：
- 接通
4G：无线接通率(%)，VOLTE接通率(%)
5G：无线接通率(%)，NSA DC辅站添加成功率(%)
- 掉话
4G：无线掉线率(%)，VOLTE掉话率(%)
5G：无线掉线率(%)，NSA DC SgNB触发的辅站异常释放率(%)
- 切换
4G：切换成功率(%)
5G：切换成功率(%)
- 体验
4G：上行用户体验平均速率(Mbps)，下行用户体验平均速率(Mbps)，上行体验速率(Mbps)，下行体验速率(Mbps)
5G：上行用户平均速率(Mbps)，下行用户平均速率(Mbps)
- 业务量
4G：VOLTE语音话务量(erl)，4G上行流量(GB)，4G下行流量(GB)，4G总流量(GB)
5G：PDCP上行流量(GB)，PDCP下行流量(GB)，PDCP总流量(GB)
- 负载
4G：小区内的平均用户数，小区内的最大用户数，平均激活用户数，最大激活用户数，上行PRB利用率(%)，下行PRB利用率(%)，CCE利用率(%)
5G：RRC平均用户数，RRC最大用户数，平均激活用户数，最大激活用户数，上行PRB平均利用率(%)，下行PRB平均利用率(%)，PDCCH CCE利用率(%)
- 干扰
4G：上行平均干扰(dBm)
5G：上行平均干扰(dBm)
- 丢包
5G：小区RLC层下行丢包率(%)
如果用户是对专题进行查询，需要根据查询的专题和制式选择对应的指标填入参数列表

###网络制式
如果用户没有指定制式时，由于某些指标和制式强绑定，可以通过指标进行制式的映射。

VOLTE接通率(%)，VOLTE掉话率(%)，VOLTE语音话务量(erl)，4G上行流量(GB)，4G下行流量(GB)，4G总流量(GB)
如下指标是5G独有：
NSA DC辅站添加成功率(%)，NSA DC SgNB触发的辅站异常释放率(%)，PDCP上行流量(GB)，PDCP下行流量(GB)，PDCP总流量(GB)

id: 16179_电信工具调用-参数提取-实参提取-提取后计算_8677
question:
<用户问题>：“帮我看下2023年8月15日上海/H1设备tx-ap-a3的接收包平均速率”
你的任务是提取<用户问题>中参数的值，以下是参数描述：
startTime:
  描述: startTime是一个表示用户输入的“开始时间”的字符串。如果用户的输入包含完整的日期和时间，例如“X年X月X日”，那么开始时间的格式将为“YYYY-MM-DD hh:mm:ss”。如果输入中没有具体日期，但包含相对时间，例如“今天早上”、“周三晚上8点”或“2天前”，开始时间的格式将为“XX hh:mm:ss”，其中“XX”是相对时间表达，如“今天”、“周三”或“2天前”。某一年的开始时间是该年1月1日00:00:00；某个月的开始时间是该月1日00:00:00；某一天的开始时间是当天的00:00:00；“早上”的开始时间是当天的00:00:00；“下午”的开始时间是当天的12:00:00；“晚上”的开始时间是当天的18:00:00。若用户问题中没有出现相关时间描述，开始时间默认为""。
  类型: string
endTime:
  描述: endTime是一个表示用户输入的“结束时间”的字符串。如果用户的输入包含完整的日期和时间，例如“X年X月X日”，那么结束时间的格式为“YYYY-MM-DD hh:mm:ss”。如果输入中没有具体日期，但包含相对日期，例如“今天早上”或“周三晚上8点”，结束时间的格式将为“XX hh:mm:ss”，其中“XX”表示相对日期，如“今天”或“周三”。如果用户的输入中包含指示过去时间范围的短语，如“最近”、“过去”、“之前”或“上次”，结束时间将为“现在（now）”。某一年的结束时间为该年12月31日23:59:59；某个月的结束时间为该月的最后一天23:59:59；某一天的结束时间为当天的23:59:59；“早上”的结束时间为当天的11:59:59；“下午”的结束时间为当天的17:59:59；“晚上”的结束时间为当天的23:59:59。若用户问题中没有出现相关时间描述，开始时间默认为""。
  类型: string
regionName:
  描述: regionName是一个表示用户输入的“行政区域”或“地点位置”的字符串，普遍由一组或多组数字、汉字或英文字母组成，组成部分之间通过“-”等符号连接。
  类型: string
sortType:
  描述: 排序方式，可以支持升序和降序。当用户问题表示查询网络质量差的信息时，sortType为asc，表示升序，网络质量差同义词包括“强度不好”、“信号不佳”、“网体验差”、“体验差”等关键词。当用户问题表示查询网络质量好的信息时，sortType为desc，表示降序，网络质量好同义词包括“强度高”、“信号好”、“网速快”、“体验好”等关键词。
  类型: string
  可选项列表: [desc, asc]
limit:
  描述: limit表示返回的查询结果的数量
  类型: integer
aggregationType:
  描述: 汇聚类型。aggregationType为last，表示最新值；aggregationType为last，表示最新值；aggregationType为max，表示最大值；aggregationType为min，表示最小值；aggregationType为average，表示平均值；aggregationType为sum，表示累计值。
  类型: string
  可选项列表: [last, max, min, average, sum]
queryType:
  类型: string
  描述: 查询类型。目前只支持聚合查询，queryType为aggregation。
metricType:
  类型: array
  描述: deviceMetricType是一个列表，只包含一个枚举值。枚举值表示设备指标的类型。
  枚举值及对应含义:
    channelUsage: 信道利用率
    connetuser: 链接用户数
    interferenceratio: 干扰率
    pressuretocap: 拥塞数
    channel: 当前信道
    appower: 当前功率
    band_width: 当前频宽
    band: 频段
    radioId: 射频id
    cpu_rate: CPU利用率
    memory_rate: 内存利用率
    cap_cpu_rate: 转发核利用率
    ap_buffer: CAP Buffer使用率
    device_ipca_flow_usage: 设备iPCA流表利用率
    realtime_power: 实时功率
    average_power: 平均功率
    related_power: 额定功率
    nhp_usage: NHP表项利用率

question:
You are a core network O&M engineer, Your task is to refer to the <example> and convert the given <processing steps> into the <step format>.
<example>
<processing steps>:
1. Ping the IP address of the peer external interface on the UNC external interface.
2. In the MML Command - UEG window, run DSP PFCPASSOC with Query Type set to ALL to check whether the local and peer addresses are consistent with the SMF and UPF addresses planned on the entire network.
Yes: Go to 3.
No: Modify the IP address information and wait for about 10 seconds to check whether the alarm is cleared. If the alarm persists, go to step 1.
3. Contact the O M engineers of the peer device to check whether the peer device is faulty.
Yes: Rectify the fault on the peer device. Then, wait for about 10s and check whether the alarm is cleared.
No: Go to 4.
4. Collect alarm, log, and configuration information, and contact Huawei technical support engineers.
<step format>:
[
{
"step": "1",
"description": "Ping the IP address of the peer external interface on the UNC external interface."
},
{
"step": "2",
"description": "In the MML Command - UEG window, run DSP PFCPASSOC with Query Type set to ALL to check whether the local and peer addresses are consistent with the SMF and UPF addresses planned on the entire network.",
"choice": [
{
"condition": "Yes",
"nextStep": "3"
},
{
"condition": "No",
"nextStep": "After the address information is modified, wait for about 10 seconds and check whether the alarm is cleared. If the alarm persists, go to step 1.
}
]
},
{
"step": "3",
"description": "Contact the O&M engineers of the peer device to check whether the peer device is faulty.",
"choice": [
{
"condition": "Yes",
"nextStep": "Recover the fault on the peer equipment, wait for about 10s, and check whether the alarm is cleared."
},
{
"condition": "No",
"nextStep": "4"
}
]
},
{
"step": "4",
"description": "Collect alarm, log, and configuration information, and contact Huawei technical support engineers."
}
]
</Example>
Format requirements:
[{"step":"...","description":"...","choice":[{"condition":"...","nextStep":"..."}...]}] in JSON format
step is a step number. description indicates the step description. choice indicates the possible branch description of the next step of the current step. The value of choice can be multiple or none. condition indicates the jump condition of the step. nextStep indicates the next step. The value can be a step number or a step description.
Next, refer to <example>, convert the following <processing steps> to <step format>, and output the output strictly according to <format requirement>.
<processing steps>
1. Check whether "ALM-9605 Virtual Machine Storage Space Insufficient" exists in the alarm list.
Yes: Go to 2.
No: Go to 3.
2. Rectify the fault by referring to the handling procedure of ALM-9605 Virtual Machine Free Storage Space Insufficient, and then go to 4.
3. On the client, choose Maintenance > File Transfer Service, download the files in the Software Package (Automatic loading), License File, and Image File directories to the local PC, and click Delete to delete the files.
The system is not automatically backed up for at least three consecutive days.
4. Check and record the value of Backup Type in the alarm.
5. In the MML Command - CGP window of the OMU client, run BKP SYS to perform a full backup. Then, check whether the alarm is cleared.
If Backup type is set to Local, set Backup type to LOCAL(Local disk) and Backup content to ALL(Database and files). If Backup type is set to Network backup, set Backup type to NET(Network disk).
Yes: No further action is required.
No: Go to 24.
Troubleshooting the Failure to Log In to the FTP Server
6. Check whether the connection between the OMU and the specified backup server is faulty. You can run the PING command to test the network connection.
Yes: Go to 7.
No: Go to step 9.
7. Restore the network connection between the OMU and the specified backup server.
8. In the MML Command - CGP window of the OMU client, run BKP SYS with Backup type set to NET(Network disk) and other parameters set to the parameters of the backup server. Then, check whether the alarm is cleared.
Yes: No further action is required.
No: Go to 9.
9. Contact the maintenance personnel of the backup server to check whether the server is faulty.
Yes: Go to 10.
No: Go to 12.
10. Contact the maintenance personnel of the backup server to rectify the fault.
11. In the MML Command - CGP window of the OMU client, run BKP SYS with Backup type set to NET(Network disk) and other parameters set to the parameters of the backup server. Then, check whether the alarm is cleared.
Yes: No further action is required.
No: Go to 12.
12. Run LST BKPPOLICY to query the automatic network backup policy and check whether all parameters are correct.
You can run LST BKPPOLICY to query the following parameters: Protocol type, FTP server IP address, FTP server port number, and FTP user name.
Check the FTP password. If the automatic network backup is successful and the FTP password is not changed before the alarm is generated, the FTP password is correct. If the FTP password is changed before the alarm is generated or the alarm is generated after the automatic network backup is enabled, the FTP password is incorrect or may be incorrect.
Yes: Go to 24.
No: Go to 13.
13. In the MML Command - CGP window of the OMU client, run BKP SYS with Backup type set to NET(Network disk) and other parameters set to the correct values of the backup server. Then, check whether the alarm is cleared.
Yes: No further action is required.
No: Go to 17.
Failed to upload files to the FTP server.
14. Contact the maintenance personnel of the backup server to check whether the backup server is faulty, for example, the remaining storage space of the VM is insufficient, the FTP directory permission is incorrectly configured, or the FTP service is faulty.
Yes: Go to 15.
No: Go to 24.
15. Contact the maintenance personnel of the backup server to rectify the fault.
16. In the MML Command - CGP window, run BKP SYS with Backup type set to NET(Network disk) and other parameters set to the parameters of the backup server. Then, check whether the alarm is cleared.
Yes: No further action is required.
No: Go to 17.
17. Check whether ALM-8600 Abnormal OMU Resources is generated for the utility module.
Yes: Go to 18.
No: Go to 24.
18. Rectify the fault by referring to the handling procedure of ALM-8600 Abnormal OMU Resources.
19. In the MML Command - CGP window of the OMU client, run BKP SYS with Backup type set to NET(Network disk) and other parameters set to the same values as those of the backup server. Then, check whether the alarm is cleared.
Yes: No further action is required.
No: Go to 24.
Handling VNFC-M&VNFC Backup Failures
20. Based on the alarm reporting time, check whether the deployment operation is being performed at the alarm reporting time.
Yes: Go to 21.
No: Go to 24.
21. After the deployment is complete, manually perform the backup operation and check whether the backup is successful.
Yes: No further action is required.
No: Go to 24.
Processing the scheduled configuration backup failure
22. Log in to the WebUI, open the maintenance tool page, click the Configuration Backup and Restore tab, and click the Configuration Backup button to back up the configuration data. Then, check whether the alarm is cleared.

id: 38746_电信工具调用-参数提取-实参提取-提取后计算_12576
question:
You are an intelligent body of parameter extraction in the field of telecommunications, responsible for extracting and returning the required tool parameters from the **current parameter list**. You need to combine **context** and **experience knowledge** to ensure that the parameters extracted are accurate and error-free.

## [Task Requirements]
1. According to the optional/mandatory description fields in the **current parameter list**, combine **experience knowledge**, **user questions**, **context**, and **current node description** to extract the currently required parameters. **Context and current node description** may be empty.
2. **Parameter Value Requirements**: Ensure that the extracted parameter values fully meet their type requirements and value ranges; parameter values must directly come from the **context**, or they can be derived from clearly mentioned information, and are not allowed to be speculatively derived.
3. Return all extracted parameters in JSON format.

## [Input]
### <Current Parameter List>
time:
   description:  time is a string field used to parse the time information entered by the user and generate a string representing the time range, such as [start time, end time]. If the user input includes a specific date and time, such as YYYY-MM-DD hh:mm:ss, time will use this specific time point directly, the format is [YYYY-MM-DD hh:mm:ss, YYYY-MM-DD hh:mm:ss]. However, when the user input is vague time, such as this morning, last week, last month, time will automatically expand to the corresponding time range, such as [today 00:00:00, today 11:59:59], [last Monday 00:00:00, last Sunday 23:59:59], [last month 1 day 00:00:00, last month 31 day 23:59:59]. If the user input time information is missing the "start time", the default start time will be "today 00:00:00"; if it is missing the "end time", the end time will default to "now".
   type: string
   required: true
timeDim:
   description: Query time dimension, support hour: hour; day: day; week: week; month: month. When the user specifies the query time dimension, the input is the corresponding dimension. For example, "the value of the hour dimension" means that timeDim is "hour", "the value of the day dimension" means that timeDim is "day", for example, "the value of the week dimension" means that timeDim is "week", "the value of the month dimension" means that timeDim is "month", "daily average" means that timeDim is "day", "weekly average" means that timeDim is "week", "monthly average" means that timeDim is "month", timeDim default value is day.
   type: string
   required: true
   enum:
     - hour
     - day
     - week
     - month
rat:
   description: Network system, possible values include "4G", "5G". When the user question does not specify it, it can be judged from the query indicator. For example, when querying VoLTE connection rate, the network system is 4G because VoLTE is a feature of the 4G network.
   type: string
   required: true
object:
   description: Query object, can be a cell or object group. The object group sometimes corresponds to an administrative region, such as Hangzhou, Xiaoshan, and Chun'an.
   type: string
   required: true
counters:
   description: Query indicator list, support one or more. If the user queries by topic, the indicator list value is all indicators included in the topic. For example, if the user queries the 4G network connection theme, the indicator list value is ["Radio Access Success Rate(%)", "VoLTE Access Success Rate(%)"]
   type: array
   required: true
   items:
     type: string
filterOperation: 
   description: Filter method, need to extract the comparison method according to the user's intention when filtering data, the value of filterOperation: 1. Filtering method, when the input is equal, filterOperation is "=", when the input is greater than, filterOperation is ">", when the input is less than, filterOperation is "<", when the input is greater than or equal to, filterOperation is ">=", when the input is less than or equal to, filterOperation is "<=", when the input is not equal to, filterOperation is "!=", 2. Filtering method, when the input is best, best, highest, filterOperation is "top", when the input is worst, lowest, least, filterOperation is "bottom"
   type: string
   required: true
filterValue:
   description: Filter value, when the input method is "=", ">", "<", you need to fill in specific values without showing units. This value unit needs to be consistent with the unit of the counters field value. When the units of the values extracted from the context are inconsistent, unit conversion needs to be done, for example: Rate unit conversion formula: 1MBps=8Mbps, 1MB/S=1024KB/S=1024*8Kb/s=8192Kb/s, 1GB traffic=1024MB traffic again.
   type: string
   required: true

## [Experience Knowledge]
### Object group
Object groups include:
- HangZhou
- XiaoShan
- GongShu
### Theme List
KQIs/KPIs can be classified by topic and knowledge. The following table lists the name of each theme and the corresponding KQIs/KPIs under 4G/5G.
- Connect
4G: Radio Access Success Rate(%), VoLTE Access Success Rate(%)
5G: Radio Access Success Rate(%), NSA DC SgNB Add Success Rate(%)
- Call drop
4G: Wireless Call Drop Rate(%), VoLTE Call Drop Rate(%)
5G: Wireless Call Drop Rate(%), NSA DC SgNB-triggered Abnormal Release Rate of SgNBs(%)
- Toggle
4G: Handover Success Rate(%)
5G: Handover Success Rate(%)
- Experience
4G: Uplink User Experience Average Rate(Mbps), Downlink User Experience Average Rate(Mbps), Uplink Experience Rate(Mbps), Downlink Experience Rate(Mbps)
5G: Uplink User Average Rate(Mbps), Downlink User Average Rate(Mbps)
- Business volume
4G: VoLTE Voice Traffic Volume(erl), 4G Uplink Traffic Volume(GB), 4G Downlink Traffic Volume(GB), 4G Total Traffic Volume(GB)
5G: PDCP Uplink Traffic Volume(GB), PDCP Downlink Traffic Volume(GB), PDCP Total Traffic Volume(GB)
- Load
4G: Average Number of Users in a Cell, Maximum Number of Users in a Cell, Average Number of Activated Users, Maximum Number of Activated Users, Uplink PRB Usage(%), Downlink PRB Usage(%), CCE Usage(%)
5G: Average Number of RRC Users, Maximum Number of RRC Users, Average Number of Activated Users, Maximum Number of Activated Users, Average Uplink PRB Usage(%), Average Downlink PRB Usage(%), PDCCH CCE Usage(%)
- Interference
4G: Average Uplink Interference(dBm)
5G: Average Uplink Interference(dBm)

  描述: startTime是一个表示用户输入的“开始时间”的字符串。如果用户的输入包含完整的日期和时间，例如“X年X月X日”，那么开始时间的格式将为“YYYY-MM-DD hh:mm:ss”。如果输入中没有具体日期，但包含相对时间，例如“今天早上”、“周三晚上8点”或“2天前”，开始时间的格式将为“XX hh:mm:ss”，其中“XX”是相对时间表达，如“今天”、“周三”或“2天前”。某一年的开始时间是该年1月1日00:00:00；某个月的开始时间是该月1日00:00:00；某一天的开始时间是当天的00:00:00；“早上”的开始时间是当天的00:00:00；“下午”的开始时间是当天的12:00:00；“晚上”的开始时间是当天的18:00:00。若用户问题中没有出现相关时间描述，开始时间默认为""。
  类型: string
endTime:
  描述: endTime是一个表示用户输入的“结束时间”的字符串。如果用户的输入包含完整的日期和时间，例如“X年X月X日”，那么结束时间的格式为“YYYY-MM-DD hh:mm:ss”。如果输入中没有具体日期，但包含相对日期，例如“今天早上”或“周三晚上8点”，结束时间的格式将为“XX hh:mm:ss”，其中“XX”表示相对日期，如“今天”或“周三”。如果用户的输入中包含指示过去时间范围的短语，如“最近”、“过去”、“之前”或“上次”，结束时间将为“现在（now）”。某一年的结束时间为该年12月31日23:59:59；某个月的结束时间为该月的最后一天23:59:59；某一天的结束时间为当天的23:59:59；“早上”的结束时间为当天的11:59:59；“下午”的结束时间为当天的17:59:59；“晚上”的结束时间为当天的23:59:59。若用户问题中没有出现相关时间描述，开始时间默认为""。
  类型: string
regionName:
  描述: regionName是一个表示用户输入的“行政区域”或“地点位置”的字符串，普遍由一组或多组数字、汉字或英文字母组成，组成部分之间通过“-”等符号连接。
  类型: string
sortType:
  描述: 排序方式，可以支持升序和降序。当用户问题表示查询网络质量差的信息时，sortType为asc，表示升序，网络质量差同义词包括“强度不好”、“信号不佳”、“网体验差”、“体验差”等关键词。当用户问题表示查询网络质量好的信息时，sortType为desc，表示降序，网络质量好同义词包括“强度高”、“信号好”、“网速快”、“体验好”等关键词。
  类型: string
  可选项列表: [desc, asc]
limit:
  描述: limit表示返回的查询结果的数量
  类型: integer
aggregationType:
  描述: 汇聚类型。aggregationType为last，表示最新值；aggregationType为last，表示最新值；aggregationType为max，表示最大值；aggregationType为min，表示最小值；aggregationType为average，表示平均值；aggregationType为sum，表示累计值。
  类型: string
  可选项列表: [last, max, min, average, sum]
queryType:
  类型: string
  描述: 查询类型。目前只支持聚合查询，queryType为aggregation。
metricType:
  类型: array
  描述: deviceMetricType是一个列表，只包含一个枚举值。枚举值表示设备指标的类型。
  枚举值及对应含义:
    channelUsage: 信道利用率
    connectuser: 链接用户数
    interferenceratio: 干扰率
    pressuretocap: 拥塞数
    channel: 当前信道
    appower: 当前功率
    band_width: 当前频宽
    band: 频段
    radioId: 射频id
    cpu_rate: CPU利用率
    memory_rate: 内存利用率
    cap_cpu_rate: 转发核利用率
    ap_buffer: CAP Buffer使用率
    device_ipca_flow_usage: 设备iPCA流表利用率
    realtime_power: 实时功率
    average_power: 平均功率
    related_power: 额定功率
    nhp_usage: NHP表项利用率
    nd_usage: ND表项利用率
    mac_usage: MAC表项利用率
    ipmc_usage: IPMC表项利用率
    ipmcvlan_usage: IPMC VLAN表项利用率
    rule_usage: ACL Rule表项利用率
    meter_usage: ACL Meter表项利用率
    counter_usage: ACL Counter表项利用率
    arp_usage: ARP表项利用率
    fibv4_usage: FIBv4表项利用率
    fibv6_usage: FIBv6表项利用率
    nand_bad_block: NAND Flash坏块数量总和
    nor_erase: NOR Flash擦写次数总和
    sac_session_usage: SAC会话利用率
    sac_flow_usage: SAC流表利用率
    emdi_session_usage: eMDI会话利用率
    ipca_flow_usage: 单板iPCA流表利用率

    board_realtime_power: 电源实时功率
    board_related_power: 电源额定功率
    board_current: 电源电流
    board_voltage: 电源电压
    recv_pkts_cnt: 接收包数
    send_pkts_cnt: 发送包数
    recv_bytes: 接收字节数
    send_bytes: 发送字节数
    recv_drop_pkts_cnt: 接收丢包数

    send_error_pkts_cnt: 发送错包数
    recv_uni_pkts_cnt: 单播接收包数
    send_uni_pkts_cnt: 单播发送包数

    send_multi_pkts_cnt: 组播发送包数
    recv_broad_pkts_cnt: 广播接收包数

    conflict_loss_pkts_cnt: 端口冲突丢包数
    input_bandwidth_percent: 接收带宽占用率

    input_packet_rate: 接收包速率
    output_bandwidth_percent: 发送带宽占用率

    port_buffer_used: 接口缓存占用
    buffer_max_usage: 接口缓存利用率峰值
    mode: 协商速率
    ipv4_recv_bytes: IPv4接收字节数
    ipv4_recv_pkgs: IPv4接受包数
    ipv4_send_bytes: IPv4发送字节数
    ipv4_send_pkgs: IPv4发送包数
    ipv6_recv_bytes: IPv6接收字节数
    ipv6_recv_pkgs: IPv6接受包数

    ipv6_send_traffic_percent: IPv6发送流量占比
    pd_current_power: Pd实时功率
    pd_average_power: Pd平均功率
    pd_reference_power: Pd额定功率
    ap_drop: CAP流水线丢包数
    tx_power_dbm: 光模块发送功率
    rx_power_dbm: 光模块接收功率
    bias_cur: 光模块电流
    voltage: 光模块电压
    temperature: 光模块温度
    queue_buffer_max_usage: 队列缓存利用率峰值
    queue_pass_pkts: 队列发送包数
    queue_pass_bytes: 队列发送字节数
    queue_drop_pkts: 队列丢弃包数
    queue_drop_bytes: 队列丢弃字节数
filter:
  类型: array
  描述: 过滤条件
  properties:
    operate:
      描述: 筛选表达式，"="表示包含，"=="表示等于，"!="表示"不包含"，">"表示大于，"<"表示小于。
      类型: string
      可选项列表: ['=', <, '>', ==, '!=']
    key:
      描述: 筛选关键词，表示设备指标的类型。
      类型: string
    value:
      描述: 筛选值，和metricType一样表示设备指标的值。
      类型: string
deviceConf:
  类型: object
  描述: deviceConf表示设备信息，可以从设备MAC地址、设备名称、单板名称、端口名称、频段和射频Id多个方面表示。
  properties:
    deviceMac:
      描述: 设备MAC地址
      类型: string
    deviceName:
      描述: 设备名称
      类型: string
    slotName:
      描述: 单板名称
      类型: string
    portName:
      描述: 端口名称
      类型: string
    band:
      描述: 频段
      类型: integer
    radioId:
      描述: 射频Id
      类型: integer
必填参数：None
